rationale: tv_iterative_supervised-claude-agentic: tv_step_init=0.05, tv_lambda_init=0.01, tv_share_steps=True, tv_clip_max=0.5, epochs=20, lr=0.05, lambda_neg=1.0, loss_base=mse, grad_clip=10.0, train_n=50, val_n=5, rationale=iter-5: KNOB=lr: 1e-2→5e-2 + grad_clip 1.0→10.0 + tv_clip_max 0.1→0.5. iter-4 SSIM=0.298537 — EXACTLY the same as iter-1/2/3 to 6 digits.
